zone: PS-2 admin POS list/show/tracker/parked Vue components
head: b0bc75987f0a117b150c829b6e34e9d6bd2ccf41
scope: raw labels, keyboard nav, aria attributes, contrast, focus management, destructive-action confirmations.

findings.title: PosOrderListComponent has a raw FR string 'N° file' (hard-coded, not i18n).
findings.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/posOrders/PosOrderListComponent.vue:88 — `<th class="db-table-head-th">N° file</th>`. All other th use `$t(...)`. Branding break (no AR/EN equivalent) and accessibility break (the column header announced by SR is locale-glued).
findings.verdict: HEAL — replace with `$t('label.queue_number')` (key likely exists; if not, add the 3 locale files).

findings.title: Vue v-for keys use the whole object (`:key="order"`, `:key="item"`) instead of stable id.
findings.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/posOrders/PosOrderListComponent.vue:99 `<tr ... v-for="order in orders" :key="order">`. resources/js/components/admin/posOrders/PosOrderShowComponent.vue:152 `v-for="item in orderItems" :key="item">`. Vue 3 dev console warns on these; the symptom is animation/transition glitches when an order is moved between status columns or when an item is toggled in the receipt. PosOrderShowComponent.vue:164,177 also do `v-for="(variation, index) in item.item_variations"` without `:key` at all (relies on parent's :key fallback, but still a lint warning).
findings.verdict: HEAL — single-file edits to set `:key="order.id"`/`:key="item.id"` + add :key on the nested v-for. Scope-minimal.

findings.title: PosOrderListComponent status filter dropdown only exposes 3 statuses — missing CANCELED / REJECTED / RETURNED / PREPARED / OUT_FOR_DELIVERY.
findings.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/posOrders/PosOrderListComponent.vue:34-41 — searchStatus options array hard-codes ACCEPT, PREPARING, DELIVERED only. The admin sees a 'History' table that they cannot filter on cancellations or refunds. The data layer (OrderService::list line 154) accepts any integer status filter, so the backend is ready. UX symptom: history scrubbing impossible from the UI.
findings.verdict: HEAL — extend the options array to include the 5 missing statuses. Pure-UI, no schema change.

findings.title: PosOrderListComponent delete icon has no UI-level guard for PAID orders — server returns 403, but the cashier has no preview.
findings.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/posOrders/PosOrderListComponent.vue:128 — `<SmIconDeleteComponent @click="destroy(order.id)" v-if="permissionChecker('pos-orders')" />`. The destroy() method (line 349) shows a SweetAlert confirm then dispatches the destroy. There is NO check on order.payment_status === PAID — the cashier clicks, confirms, then sees a backend error. Server-side OrderService::destroy at line 2202-2205 returns 403 'Paid orders cannot be destroyed without elevated permission.' UX would be cleaner if the icon were disabled (or visually muted) when payment_status === PAID and the actor doesn't carry pos-destroy-paid.
findings.verdict: HEAL — gate the icon on `order.payment_status !== paymentStatusEnum.PAID || permissionChecker('pos-destroy-paid')`. Pure-UI.

findings.title: ParkedOrdersComponent discard button has NO confirm dialog — single click destructively deletes the parked cart.
findings.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/pos/ParkedOrdersComponent.vue:84-91 — discard button calls discardOrder(order.id) directly. methods at line 204-214 dispatch posParked/discard with no confirm. Restore action at line 76-83 has appropriate UX (loading spinner, busyId), but accidental discard cannot be undone (the row is hard-deleted by PosParkedOrderService::discard line 195-202). Risk: 'thumb-fat finger' on a busy POS deletes a parked customer's order. Tracker's cancel-order flow has a proper modal with reason+confirm (PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:239+) — same UX rigor is missing here.
findings.verdict: HEAL — wrap discardOrder() in a confirm dialog (browser confirm() is acceptable for V1; a proper modal mirroring the cancel-order one is V1.0.2).

findings.title: PosOrdersTrackerComponent has solid aria + role=tablist + role=alert + aria-live and a proper cancel dialog with focus management.
findings.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/pos/PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:45 `role="tablist" :aria-label="..."` ; line 50-55 each tab has aria-selected; line 198-202 cancel icon has :title + :data-testid for E2E; line 239 modal has `aria-modal="true"`, `:aria-labelledby` ; line 270 reason textarea + line 291 error banner has `role="alert"` + `aria-live="assertive"` ; line 673 nextTick focus on cancel reason input. Reference UX pattern.

findings.title: PosOrderListComponent search has no `aria-label` on the order_serial_no input but does have `<label for>`.
findings.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/posOrders/PosOrderListComponent.vue:25-27 — visible label + for/id pair, accessible. The vue-select for status filter at line 34 lacks aria-label but uses an adjacent <label for="searchStatus">. The Datepicker at line 60 has `aria-labels.input` set. All inputs SR-reachable.

findings.title: ParkedOrdersComponent has clean focus + close UX (drawer close button, click outside, ESC implicit via overlay click).
findings.evidence: ParkedOrdersComponent.vue:3 `@click.self="closeDrawer"` ; line 10 close button. No ESC handler but the close on overlay click + close button cover the standard exits. The drawer's transition (.parked-orders-slide) is properly defined in scoped CSS.
findings.verdict: KEEP (minor: ESC keyboard handler is a V1.0.2 polish item).

summary: Tracker UX is exemplary (modal with focus, role/aria, error banner). List + Parked components have 3 clear quick wins: P1 i18n 'N° file' + P2 v-for keys + P2 status filter coverage + P2 PAID delete UI guard + P2 parked-discard confirm. All are scope-minimal, single-file edits on non-DIRTY files. No P0. Frontend a11y baseline is solid.
